title: 第9章 虚拟世界第10章 城际副本
lines: 第9章虚拟世界
一中的训练场馆设施完善，只要是一中的学生，都可以免费入内使用。
中午这会儿，训练场馆内人并不多，白牧野三人进来的时候，姬彩衣和司音已经等候在这里。
“会用吧？”单谷指了指那边的虚拟仓，看着白牧野问道。
白牧野摇摇头：“不会。”
“你没进过虚拟世界？”单谷瞪大眼睛，一脸不可思议的看着白牧野。
“没有。”白牧野一脸坦然。
还真是干脆啊！
这么大了没进过虚拟世界？没玩过虚拟游戏？
不会用虚拟仓？难道不觉得有一点点惭愧么？还有一点点骄傲的样子是什么鬼？不玩游戏的好孩子么？
单谷心里面腹诽着。
虚拟世界早已经成为人们的第二家园。
高中以上的学生或是成年人，都可以在虚拟世界中接任务，也可以通过打比赛或是下副本获得大量积分。
副本积分可以换取各种现实中的修炼资源和技能。
重要的大型比赛积分，甚至可以直接兑换成高考分数！
比如万雄之前的飞仙星高中生联赛第九名，获得的积分和奖励都让人无比羡慕。
单谷给白牧野介绍着相关知识，同时教他使用虚拟仓。
其实很简单，都是高度智能化的东西，只要坐进去，虚拟仓会自动扫描身体数据，然后将信息传递到虚拟平台。
就连身上的符篆，都可以直接扫描进去。
白牧野身上没带符篆，而且他多少有些担心，虚拟仓会不会把他真实精神力给扫描出来。
要是那样，乐子可就大了。
不过事到如今，他也没办法退缩。
未来需要使用虚拟仓的时候多了去了，总不能一直不接触吧。
白牧野多少有些忐忑的坐进虚拟仓的座椅中，半躺着，放松精神。
座椅包裹性非常好，感觉还挺舒服的。
下一刻，虚拟仓启动，眼前一变，直接进入到虚拟世界当中。
眼前一个面板，记录着他的精神力。
白牧野第一时间看了一眼，随后松了口气。
老头子还是靠谱的，符篆师宝典……也是靠谱的！
被封印的精神力，并没有显示出来。
面板上显示着他的精神力二十一，灵力一百！
嘿，这上居然还能显示灵力？
白牧野看见精神力二十一的时候松了口气，这么几天的功夫，又涨了一点。
当看见灵力值居然也有一百的时候，有种意外的惊喜。
他从来没修炼过灵力，没想居然也有这么高，已经勉强达到四级灵战士的标准了。
这时候，刘志远、单谷、姬彩衣和司音等人，也都已经进来。
虽然是虚拟世界，但却有着跟现实一样的各种感知。
视觉、味觉、嗅觉、痛感等，都跟现实中一样。
当然，痛感是可以调的，最低百分之十，最高百分之五十。
不可能百分之百还原，搞不好会出人命的。
事实上，绝大多数人在虚拟世界中，用的都是现实百分之十的痛感，
毕竟有受虐倾向的人没多少，也别扯什么在虚拟世界中磨砺自己的意志，不信拿把刀在自己手上划个口，看疼不疼？
content_en:
Chapter 9 Virtual World
The training venues of No. 1 Middle School are well-equipped and all students of No. 1 Middle School can enter and use them for free.
At noon, there were not many people in the training venue. When Bai Muye and the others came in, Ji Caiyi and Si Yin were already waiting here.
"Can you use it?" Shan Gu pointed to the virtual warehouse over there and looked at Bai Muye and asked.
Bai Muye shook his head: "No."
"Have you never entered a virtual world?" Shan Gu stared at Bai Muye with wide eyes and a look of disbelief on his face.
"No." Bai Muye said calmly.
It’s really simple!
Have you never entered a virtual world at this age? Never played a virtual game?
Don’t know how to use virtual warehouse? Don't you feel a little ashamed? What the hell is a little proud? A good boy who doesn't play games?
Shan Gu cursed in his heart.
The virtual world has already become people's second home.
Students above high school or adults can take on tasks in the virtual world, and can also earn a lot of points by playing competitions or downloading dungeons.
Dungeon points can be exchanged for various real-life training resources and skills.
Points from important large-scale competitions can even be directly converted into college entrance examination scores!
For example, when Wan Xiong ranked ninth in the Feixianxing High School League, the points and rewards he received were extremely enviable.
Shan Gu introduced relevant knowledge to Bai Muye and taught him how to use the virtual warehouse.
In fact, it is very simple. They are highly intelligent things. As long as you sit in, the virtual cabin will automatically scan your body data and then transmit the information to the virtual platform.
Even the talismans on the body can be scanned directly.
Bai Muye didn't have a talisman on him, and he was somewhat worried whether the virtual warehouse would scan out his true mental power.
If that were the case, it would be great fun.
But now, he couldn't back down.
There will be many times when we need to use virtual warehouses in the future, so we can’t stay away from them forever.
Bai Muye sat down in the seat of the virtual warehouse somewhat uneasily, half-lying down, relaxing.
The seats are very well wrapped and feel quite comfortable.
The next moment, the virtual warehouse was activated, and his eyes suddenly changed, and he entered the virtual world directly.
There is a panel in front of him that records his mental power.
Bai Muye glanced at it for the first time, and then breathed a sigh of relief.
The old man is still reliable, and the Talisman Seal Master's Manual... is also reliable!
The sealed mental power was not displayed.
The panel shows that his spiritual power is twenty-one and his spiritual power is one hundred!
Hey, this can actually show spiritual power?
Bai Muye breathed a sigh of relief when he saw that his mental strength was twenty-one. Over the past few days, it had increased a little.
When I saw that the spiritual power value was actually one hundred, I was pleasantly surprised.
He had never practiced spiritual power before, and he never expected to reach such a high level. He had barely reached the level of a fourth-level spiritual warrior.
At this time, Liu Zhiyuan, Shan Gu, Ji Caiyi, Si Yin and others had also come in.
Although it is a virtual world, it has the same various perceptions as reality.
Vision, taste, smell, pain, etc. are all the same as in reality.
Of course, the pain can be adjusted, from a minimum of 10% to a maximum of 50%.
It's impossible to restore it 100%, and people might die.
In fact, most people in the virtual world use 10% of the pain of reality.
After all, there aren't many people with masochistic tendencies, so let's not talk about sharpening one's will in the virtual world. If you don't believe it, take a knife and cut a cut on your hand to see if it hurts?
